metrics.profile_summary: Experienced journalist and content creator with over 9 years of professional experience in research and writing. Recently pivoted into digital marketing with technical training in SEO, GA4, and paid advertising.

education.institution: Federal Urdu University of Arts, Science & Technology

experience.description: Executes digital content strategy, SEO, and social media management using Google Analytics, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.
Produces blogs and columns on political and non-political current affairs.
Conducted field reporting, interviews, and investigative copywriting.
Monitored news channels, created headlines, and handled international desk news translations.
Field reporting and team supervision during LGE Karachi coverage.
Conducted research and copywriting in Urdu.

strengths: Possesses required technical knowledge of GA4 and ad platforms
weaknesses: Lacks 5-7 years of dedicated marketing experience
No evidence of managing marketing budgets or reporting ROI/CAC/LTV
Insufficient people management experience for a Managerial role
Background is primarily journalism, not consumer brand marketing
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a skilled journalist with recent digital marketing certifications. While they meet the 'must-have' technical tool requirements, they lack the professional seniority, strategic marketing experience, and leadership track record required for a Marketing Manager position.
